main_text.p: facti memoria ne periret cautum est proverbio لامر ما جدع قصير ادفه i. e. Ob causam aliquam abscidit ubi Kojair nasum. Est & ab Amro proverbium كبر عمرو عن الطوق i. e. Major est Amrus quam ultorque indunatur.[?]
5 امرء القيس Amrio'l Kais, Amri filius: cui cognomen البدا Albada, i. e. الاول Primus.[?]

6 عمرو Amrus, Amrisil Kaisi filius: Floruit regnante apud Persas Saburo Dil Aclaf سابورذي الاكتاف i. e. Sabur, Scapularum Domino (qui inde dictus quòd Arabum, quos devicerat,{*} scapulas abscinderet, (non quòd ipse latis humeris prædirus esset, ut autumat doctissimus Schichardus.) Mater ipsi fuit ماريه, cujus inaures in proverbium abiere قرطا ماريه inaures Maria.AbulFeda
7 اوس Aus, Kalami قلام filius, Amalekitai
8 Alius quidam ex Amalekitis ἀνώνυμος[?] deinde reverso ad Lachamidas regno.
9 امرو القيس Amriolkais, Amri filius, cognominatus المحرق Almobrek, i. e. uster, quod primus fuerit qui fontes igne cruciavit. أول من عاقب بالنار

10 النعمان الاعور AlNeoman alawar i. Luscus Amriol Kaisi filius, qui cùm annos triginta regnâsset, ترهد وخرج من الملك i. e. Rerum mundanarum curam abjecit & regno se abdicavit, dicens اي خير في ملك اخره الي دفان i. e. Quid prodest regnum, quod certò periturum est? Factum hoc regnante apud Persas, بهرام جسور Bahram Ianr Tazdejerdi filio. Condiisse fertur AlNeoman iste decantatas

page.notes: Arabic words are copied from the scan as best as legible; those marked [?] or with uncertain letters (e.g. امرء, البدا, ادفه, ماريه, قلام) should be checked against the original. The Greek word "ἀνώνυμος" in paragraph 8 is read from a worn print and is marked [?]. "indunatur" is uncertain. The printed ornament (small dot) after "Maria." was not transcribed. The "Digitized by Google" credit at the foot was excluded. Page continues onto the next page at "decantatas".
